subject: Workplace Skills
title: Your Digital Presence
description: A quick, practical guide to Your Digital Presence.

hook.text: Your Slack profile, response patterns, and emoji usage collectively form your remote personality.

buildup.text: In the office, people read your energy. Remotely, they read your profile photo, status, and message tone.

discovery.text: A complete profile with photo, timezone, role, and working hours helps colleagues work with you effortlessly.

twist.text: Slow response times often signal disengagement, even when you're deep in focused work. Status updates help.

climax.text: Set your status when in deep work, in meetings, or offline. Let people know before they assume.

punchline.text: Curate your digital presence like a storefront.

quiz.question: Why is your digital presence important in remote work?
options: It replaces the physical impressions colleagues form in offices
Remote companies rank employees by profile completeness
It helps IT track your working hours
